demo_cases.title: Wrong access VLAN assigned to host port
demo_cases.symptom: PC-A (192.168.20.10/24) cannot reach servers in VLAN 20. The host replies to ping within its own IP but cannot reach 192.168.20.2. PC-A should be in the SERVERS VLAN (20).
demo_cases.topology: PC-A -- Gi0/2 -- SwitchA -- Gi0/1 -- RouterB. Intended: PC-A belongs to VLAN 20 (SERVERS).
demo_cases.show_output:
show vlan brief
VLAN Name                             Status    Ports
---- -------------------------------- --------- -----------------------------
1    default                          active
10   USERS                            active    Fa0/2 Fa0/3
20   SERVERS                          active    Fa0/5

show interfaces status
Port      Name               Status       Vlan       Duplex Speed   Type
Gi0/1     trunk-to-RouterB   connected    trunk      a-full  a-1000  1000BaseSX
Gi0/2     to-PC-A            connected    10         a-full  a-1000
Gi0/3                        connected    10         a-full  a-1000
Gi0/5                        connected    20         a-full  a-1000

show interfaces switchport
Name               : Gi0/2
Switchport Mode      : access
Access Mode VLAN     : 10
demo_cases.expected_fault: Port Gi0/2 is assigned to access VLAN 10 (USERS) instead of VLAN 20 (SERVERS)
demo_cases.expected_fix: On SwitchA, enter interface Gi0/2 and run: switchport access vlan 20

demo_cases.title: OSPF neighbor stuck in INIT (area mismatch)
demo_cases.symptom: Routes are not being learned via OSPF; the neighbor stays in a non-FULL state.
demo_cases.topology: RouterA and RouterB form an OSPF adjacency that never reaches FULL due to an area mismatch.
demo_cases.show_output:
show ip ospf neighbor
Neighbor ID     Pri   State           Dead Time   Interface ID    Interface
10.0.0.2        128   INIT/DROTHER    00:00:05    3               Ethernet0/0

show ip ospf interface brief
Interface    Area    Cost  State
Ethernet0/0  0       10    DR
Vlan10       1       10    DR
demo_cases.expected_fault: OSPF neighbor 10.0.0.2 is stuck in INIT state due to an area mismatch (area 0 vs area 1)
demo_cases.expected_fix: Put both interfaces in the same OSPF area

demo_cases.title: Corporate SSID mapped to the wrong VLAN
demo_cases.symptom: Wireless clients connecting to the CORP SSID receive an IP in the guest subnet and cannot reach corporate resources.
demo_cases.topology: The CORP SSID (CORP-WiFi) is mapped to VLAN 999 (guest) instead of VLAN 10 (corporate).
demo_cases.show_output:
show dot11 ssid
SSID         Vlan     Status
CORP-WiFi    999      Active
GUEST-WiFi   999      Active

show running-config | section ssid
dot11 ssid CORP-WiFi
   vlan 999
   authentication open

show ip dhcp snooping binding
Mac Address          IP address        Lease(sec)  Type           Vlan  Interface
0011.2233.4400       192.168.99.50     86400       dhcp-snooping  999   Fa0/8
demo_cases.expected_fault: CORP-WiFi SSID maps to VLAN 999 (guest) instead of VLAN 10 (corporate); clients get a guest IP
demo_cases.expected_fix: Map CORP-WiFi to the correct corporate VLAN: vlan 10 under the ssid
